## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

Record the relevant checks and any remaining failures or limits.

## Documentation impact

Name the affected coverage IDs and canonical articles from `docs/documentation/COVERAGE.md` and `articles.json`. Link the guide/evidence updates, or give a specific reason this change has no reader impact. Request a documentation review when changes affect controls, permissions, prerequisites, configuration, recovery, or supported builds.

For behavior changes, name the independent walkthrough reviewer and the recorded app build. For copy-only changes, retain the previous observations and record the new content hash and review classification. Follow `docs/documentation/MAINTENANCE.md` before release.
